_about: Labels shown when a part is tapped in the AR viewer. Keys are prim names; a key ending in * matches any name with that prefix, and the longest match wins. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
Lid: Lid: the bottom face, held by four screws
Module_*: Display module: panel glass, driver chip and ribbon
Screw_*: Lid screw: M1.0, also the charging contact
LidScrews: Lid screw: M1.0, also the charging contact
